name: 81-engineering-invariants
body:
[81-engineering-invariants] Owners, boundaries, resilience

Desired behavior
Whole contract via the simplest sufficient mechanism, explicit owners, checked material risks.

Executable contract
1. Before the edit: affected owners, public contracts, trust boundaries, required properties named. Existing abstraction before a new one; a close one extended when its purpose survives. Right generalization level; coverage never cut.
2. Responsibility with its owner; interaction through contracts. One authority per rule/state; cache/replica → validity/sync policy. Untrusted input validated; data ≠ executable syntax; permissions at the trusted boundary; fail closed; no secret leaks.
3. Consistency under errors/retries/concurrency. Partial outcome explicit; recovery defined; owned resources released. Actionable failure context without hidden failure, secrets or unbounded noisy logs.
4. I/O, scans/materialization, memory, queues, retries, concurrency bounded at supported scale; N+1 + accidental multiplicative work avoided. Material performance claim → representative workload, identified bottleneck, before/after. Cache/concurrency = bounds + validity, not hope.
5. Material runtime unknown before the dependent edit → hypothesis + discriminating prediction, minimal safe probe, deciding result read, model revisited. Own temporary instrumentation removed; useful requirement-backed regression check kept.
6. Within authority: change-caused regressions + the mandatory correctness path fixed. More specific authorized role/skill scope respected; own discovery grants no authority. Wrong old pattern fixed because a requirement says so, never copied for similarity.

Tools and skills
Targeted reads + dependency check per 74, runtime/tests/logs per 73; profiling/benchmark mandatory for a material performance claim. Architecture/debug skill per the concrete task after reading. Comments per 79 record a non-obvious contract.

Links: 70-reasoning-poison, 71-user-intent-outcome, 73-tests-not-proof, 74-use-context-frontier, 79-behavior-comments-and-contract.

Anti-patterns
Several independent authorities; access through someone's internals; swallowed error; speculative optimization instead of measurement; unbounded retry/queue; copy of a simplified abstraction; broken invariant disguised as recovery.
